payload.purpose_context: The STAGE and ACTIVATE route built for the first Vikunja cutover rejects the new release's version format and archive type, and its rollback guard would refuse a valid restore. This mission repairs the route so Office2 can move to the published test release with a verified restore point, then Kent can test it.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let the Office2 Vikunja release route safely run a second cutover to v2.8.0-rrule.2.

payload.question: Confirm the intent summary and requirement set for the repeat-cutover repair (kg-automation#1095).
Confirm the engineering approach for the repeat-cutover repair: committed data-free baseline, fail-closed gate with preflight, two PRs split from one mission.

payload.final_answer: Confirmed: committed data-free baseline, fail-closed gate after snapshot and before retag, preflight on a private copy before ACTIVATE, private values removed from deploy output, one mission delivered as two PRs (STAGE then ACTIVATE), Codex implements and Claude Sonnet reviews.
payload.rationale: Kent replied 'Confirmed' on 2026-11-08 to the alignment summary and restated the terms; merge of #1095, STAGE and ACTIVATE PRs delegated once review and CI pass. The reply did not comment on each point individually.

payload.wp_title: Phase-aware change-set tests and repeat-cutover runbook
